title: Fasting glucose in the illustrative 60-person cohort, bins 10 mg/dL wide
alt: Histogram of 60 fasting glucose values, one hump peaking between 135 and 145 mg/dL with a longer tail to the right.
longDescription: Sixty fasting glucose values are grouped into nine bins 10 mg/dL wide, running from 95 to 185 mg/dL. Counts rise from 1 person in the 95 to 105 bin to 13 people in the 135 to 145 bin, then fall to 2 people in the 175 to 185 bin. The bins are 1, 3, 6, 11, 13, 12, 8, 4 and 2 people. The cohort has one hump rather than two, so a single centre describes it sensibly. The left side falls away faster than the right, so the tail reaching towards 185 mg/dL is longer than the tail reaching towards 95 mg/dL. The mean of 142 mg/dL, marked by a vertical line, sits just right of the tallest bin. Six people sit at or above 165 mg/dL and one sits below 105 mg/dL; both groups are invisible in the mean.
